verses.1: And the sons of Issachar will be brought back, and Pua will return too. And Shimeron will be four in number.
verses.2: And the sons of Tolai, Uziel, Rephaiah, Eriel, Jaahmiel, and Yibsham. And Shmuael was the chief among them. They were all taken to the houses of their ancestors. Among them were the rulers of the people, who were taken by their families during David’s time. There were forty-two thousand in total.
verses.3: And the sons of Uziel will be Zerachya. And the sons of Zerachya are Mikhael, Obadiah, and Joel Yishiyah. They are five in total.
verses.4: And they were brought back to their mothers’ homes. There were thirty-six thousand soldiers who fought in that war. It was so many women and children.
verses.5: And they gave them to all the daughters of Ishmael, the leaders of the tribes. There were seven thousand of them who were given to them.
verses.6: Binyamin, Bal’a, and Be’ker; and Yidiyael, three in total.
verses.7: And the sons of Bela were Etzbon, Uzi, Uziyael, Viremot, and Irimi. There were also five heads of families among them. They were the rulers of the tribes. In total, there were forty-two people.
verses.8: And the sons of Bokher were Zemirah, Yoash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Amri, Yirimot, Abiya, and Anathoth. All these were the sons of Bokher.
verses.9: And their mothers became rulers over their households. The leaders of the tribes were hundreds and thousands.
verses.10: And the sons of Yediel Bilaan, and the sons of Bilaan will also do so. And the people of Nimin, Ehuad, Kanaanah, Zitan, Tarshish, and Ahishchar will also do the same.
verses.11: All these sons of Jediel were the leaders of the commanders of the armies. There were seventy or eighty thousand of them, and they all came out to fight in battle.
verses.12: And their children were cursed and defiled. The children of the city were also cursed.
verses.13: The sons of Naphtali will be Jehiel, Guni, Yizreel, and Shalom. They are the sons of Bilha.
verses.14: The sons of Manasseh, Asheriel. Asheriel gave birth to Philagsho, the Arumiah. Philagsho gave birth to Makir, my father Gilad.
verses.15: And Makir took a woman for his wives and concubines. His first wife’s name was Ma’achah, and the second wife’s name was Zelphachad. She became the mother of Zelphachad’s children.
verses.16: And Maacha gave birth to a son. She named him Paresh, and her brother’s name was Sharash. Their sons were Ulaqem.
verses.17: And the sons of Olam were these: the sons of Gilead, sons of Makir, sons of Manasseh.
verses.18: And her daughter, the queen, gave birth to Ahishod, Abijezar, and Mahlah.
verses.19: And the sons of Shemida became brothers and sisters. And they were taken away by Aniyam.
verses.20: And the sons of Ephraim were Suthelah, and Berd; and under them were Eladah and Tachan.
verses.21: And Zabad’s son, and Shutelach’s son, and Ezer and Elad, they were killed by the people of Gath. They came down from their homes to take what belonged to them.
verses.22: And Ephraim wept for their father for many days. Then his brothers came to comfort him.
verses.23: And he went to his wife. She got up and gave birth to a son. He named him “Reuva”, because she had been sick in her house.
verses.24: And in her daughter’s house, she built the lower part of the house, as well as the upper part. She also built the entrance to the house.
verses.25: And Rephah will be his son, and Rechef will be his son. And Telach will be his son, and Tahan will also be his son.
verses.26: For Adon, his people were the Israelites; for Eliashama, his descendants were also Israelites.
verses.28: And their homes and their settlements were in Bethel and its daughters. Also in the east, there was a place called Nahanan; and in the west, there was a place called Gazer. And their daughters also lived there.
verses.29: And by the daughters of Manasseh, Bet She’an will be destroyed. And by their daughters, Taanach will be destroyed. And by their daughters, Megiddo will be destroyed. And by their daughters, Dor will be destroyed. And by their daughters, Be’elolah will be destroyed. These are the places where the sons of Joseph, son of Israel, will dwell.
verses.30: The sons of Asher: Yimna, Shisha, Shivi, and Bria. They lived together as brothers.
verses.31: And the sons of Beria were brothers; and Malchiah was their father.
verses.32: And his neighbors were Yaflet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shu’a.
verses.33: And the sons of Yaflet were Pasach, and Mhal, and Aswat. These are the sons of Yaflet.
verses.34: And the sons of Shamar: Ahhiwaw, Rahag, Huvah, and Aram.
verses.35: And Ben-Helom’s brothers were Zofach, Yimnay, and Shelekh.
verses.36: Bnei Tzofach, Suhak, Harnefer, Shual, Bery, and Yimra.
verses.37: Bezer, Hod, Shamá, Shilshá, Yitran, and Be’ará.
verses.38: And the sons of Yeter will be beautiful and splendid.
verses.39: And sons of Elah: Arah and Haniyel and Rizya.
verses.40: All these sons of Ashur were the leaders of the fathers’ houses. They were the rulers of the armies. They were the heads of the commanders. Together, they formed a powerful force in battle. In total, there were forty people, and six thousand men.
